description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter for the home screen's sections in an Android app, including header, banner, and content rows, along with associated view holders and data models.

classes.name: HomeSectionsAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter managing different section types for the home screen, including header, banner, and content rows.

classes.name: HomeSectionsAdapter.HeaderSectionVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for header section containing brand text and top navigation RecyclerView.

classes.name: HomeSectionsAdapter.BannerSectionVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for banner section containing a horizontally scrolling list of banners.

classes.name: HomeSectionsAdapter.ContentRowSectionVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for content row section containing a title and horizontal list of content cards.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates and creates appropriate ViewHolder based on view type.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder based on item type.

methods.name: SectionDiff.areItemsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if two section items are the same based on their type and identifiers.

methods.name: SectionDiff.areContentsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if the content of two section items are identical.

methods.name: HeaderSectionVH.bind
methods.description: Binds header data, setting styled brand text and configuring top navigation RecyclerView.

methods.name: BannerSectionVH.bind
methods.description: Binds banner data to the horizontal RecyclerView, sets size, padding, and scroll behaviors.

methods.name: ContentRowSectionVH.bind
methods.description: Binds content row data, sets up inner RecyclerView for horizontal scrolling, and manages focus.
